boundary: One unchanged complete small-configuration workload. Success-only reflected synchronous phases use normal worker, executable code, owners, initialization, publication and projection. Public warm/fresh lanes use the unmodified synchronous API. Fresh compilation and compiled-owner disposal are inside that total, with compilation also recorded inside each observation. Reset/verification excluded from these diagnostic clocks.
limitations: Reflection/decorator/stopwatch overhead included. Phase allocation is current-thread sync only; public allocation is process-wide and may include unrelated runtime work. Host elapsed is nested inside execution/publication; subtract only matching per-observation sums, never medians. No CPU-share, startup, CPython comparison or stable performance claim from this experiment.
